patterns.message: Production code under src/ must not import test-only modules. test/helpers/dom.mjs wraps happy-dom, a devDependency; importing it from src/ compiles happy-dom into the production bundle.

Production code under src/ must not import happy-dom directly. It is a devDependency used only by test/helpers/dom.mjs; importing it from src/ ships happy-dom plus ws, whatwg-mimetype, buffer-image-size and entities into .next/server. Guarding only the harness path left this one-line route open.
